classical_theorem.fixed_set_dichotomy: Fix(T_theta^n)=R^2 if n*theta is in 2*pi*Z and {(0,0)} otherwise
classical_theorem.irrational_case: if alpha=theta/(2*pi) is irrational, #Fix(T_theta^n)=1 for every n>=1 and zeta_AM(z)=1/(1-z)
classical_theorem.period_structure: irrational angles have only the origin as a periodic point; a reduced rational angle of order b>1 gives the origin plus an uncountable continuum of exact period-b points
classical_theorem.rational_case: if alpha=a/b in lowest terms, Fix(T_theta^n)=R^2 exactly when b divides n; the classical Artin--Mazur series is undefined
classical_theorem.zero_angle_edge: theta=0 has the entire plane fixed at n=1 and the classical Artin--Mazur series is undefined

gaussian_koopman_theorem.basis_range: k>=0 and m in Z form a complete orthonormal basis of L^2(R^2,gamma)
gaussian_koopman_theorem.invariance: T_theta preserves the normalized Gaussian measure for every theta
gaussian_koopman_theorem.irrational_spectrum: for irrational theta/(2*pi), the eigenvalues exp(i*m*theta) are distinct and dense on the unit circle, each with countably infinite radial multiplicity
gaussian_koopman_theorem.rational_spectrum: for reduced theta/(2*pi)=a/b, the spectrum is the b-th roots of unity and each eigenspace has countably infinite multiplicity

nonclaims: finite fixed counts at rational resonant iterates
an ordinary Fredholm determinant for either non-trace-class unitary
a heat-regularized determinant as a determinant of the physical strobe
a single-valued quantum unitary family on the classical 2*pi time quotient
a prime correspondence, target divisor, functional equation, or counting-law match
arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, or automorphy
a Hilbert--Polya operator, Route-B authorization, novelty priority, external peer review, or acceptance score

progress_and_boundary.clock_boundary: heat damping, Wick rotation, Hermite truncation, and finite-rank compression define different clocks or operators
progress_and_boundary.cover_boundary: the classical and Gaussian families are 2*pi-periodic, while the quantum unitary family retains its metaplectic sign and is 4*pi-periodic
progress_and_boundary.operator_boundary: both natural unitary lifts are noncompact and outside every finite Schatten class, so neither owns an ordinary trace-class Fredholm determinant
progress_and_boundary.progress: one all-angle theorem unifies the classical fixed-set transition, exact Gaussian Koopman spectrum, and same-clock quantum oscillator spectrum
progress_and_boundary.route_boundary: the natural quantum lift cannot compensate for failed arithmetic, primitive-orbit, target-divisor, or global-analytic gates

quantum_theorem.heat_wick_boundary: exp(-t*Hhat) for t>0 is a different imaginary-time heat clock and cannot replace Q_theta in this evaluation
quantum_theorem.metaplectic_periodicity: Q_(theta+2*pi)=-Q_theta and Q_(theta+4*pi)=Q_theta, so the lift is 4*pi-periodic and projectively 2*pi-periodic without discarding the global sign
quantum_theorem.parameter_domain: Q_theta is an operator family on physical real time theta in R, not a single-valued unitary family on R/(2*pi*Z)
quantum_theorem.rational_spectrum: for the exact real-time representative theta/(2*pi)=a/b in lowest terms, the spectrum is exp(-i*pi*a/b) times the b-th roots, each with infinite multiplicity
quantum_theorem.same_clock: Q_theta=exp(-i*theta*Hhat) uses the same physical real time theta as the classical strobe
quantum_theorem.self_adjoint_generator: Hhat is self-adjoint on its standard oscillator domain

source_lock.angle_coordinate: q-i*p=r*exp(i*phi), so phi advances by theta
source_lock.clock: theta in R is the physical Hamiltonian time at unit frequency
source_lock.determinant_convention: classical Artin--Mazur cardinality series and ordinary trace-class Fredholm determinant only
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero or prime tables, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya claims, heat/Wick clock substitution, and Route B
source_lock.parameter_domain: theta is physical real time in R; only the classical and Gaussian Koopman projections are taken modulo 2*pi
source_lock.precision: exact integer, rational, symbolic, Laguerre, Hermite, and cyclotomic algebra
source_lock.quantum_cover: Q_(theta+2*pi)=-Q_theta and Q_(theta+4*pi)=Q_theta; the unitary family is 4*pi-periodic and only projectively 2*pi-periodic
source_lock.strobe: T_theta=Phi_theta for every physical theta in R and T_(theta+2*pi)=T_theta
